children: ), a leading energy infrastructure company delivering integrated solutions to create reliable power and modernize infrastructure, and Roseburg Urban Sanitary Authority (RUSA) will host a ribbon cutting ceremony to celebrate the completion of a new solar and battery energy storage system (BESS) at RUSA's Main Office. The installation pairs a 39.4-kWDC solar photovoltaic system with a 50 kW / 184 kWh BESS, expected to offset approximately 100% of the Main Office's electrical consumption while delivering more than 24 hours of onsite backup power during grid disruptions, improving power reliability for critical operations that serve the Roseburg community.

The project was funded through a combination of support from the Oregon Department of Energy's Community Renewable Energy Program (C-REP), Energy Trust of Oregon, and Roseburg Urban Sanitary Authority.

The Main Office installation is the first phase of a broader energy infrastructure initiative developed in collaboration with Ameresco, which also includes planned solar PV projects at RUSA's Wastewater Treatment Plant (WWTP) and Natural Treatment System (NTS). The full initiative is expected to generate approximately 1.8 GWh of renewable electricity annually across all three facilities, ultimately reducing long-term costs and strengthening community resilience.

The initiative has been recognized as a model for how agencies can implement integrated, replicable renewable energy infrastructure strategies, having recently been awarded two 2026 Best of the Best Awards from the Oregon Association of Clean Water Agencies and PNCWA Excellence in Resource Recovery & Sustainability Award for 2026. The recognitions reflect RUSA & Ameresco’s shared commitment to modernizing energy infrastructure and delivering lasting value to the region.

Ameresco is a trusted full lifecycle partner, delivering over $15 billion in solutions and contracting over 5 GW of energy resources since its founding in 2000. Headquartered in Massachusetts, Ameresco serves public and private sector customers across North America and Europe. Learn more at www.ameresco.com.

Roseburg Urban Sanitary Authority (RUSA) is a public utility dedicated to the management and treatment of wastewater for the City of Roseburg and the outlying area included in the Urban Growth Boundary. Established to protect public health and the environment, RUSA operates a Wastewater Treatment Plant (WWTP) and a Natural Treatment System (NTS), focusing on sustainable water management practices. Committed to innovation and community welfare, RUSA continuously strives to implement renewable energy solutions and infrastructure upgrades, positioning itself as a leader in environmentally responsible wastewater management. RUSA’s mission is to provide high-quality services while promoting resource conservation and reducing the environmental impact of its operations.
